doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Halsey Stevens and listening to Bartok in Memphis
summary: Asked about Halsey Stevens, Lloyd says he and Booker listened to Bartok's Concerto for Orchestra and quartets back in Memphis.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Yeah, and I know that he had wrote the book on Bartok and America.
Bartok. See, here’s the thing: Booker and I were listening to a lot of Bartok ­ Bartok’s Concerto for Orchestra...
And we would listening to his string quartets too.
We were listening to this stuff in Memphis.
I knew this! I felt it!
